note: These checks test traceability and consistency with the selected abstracts. They do not verify scientific accuracy or study quality. Review every slide against its listed sources before presenting.

checks.name: Finding statements trace to valid reference sources
checks.details: All empirical finding bullets, main messages, and notes sentences cite approved reference sources.

checks.name: Finding statements supported by cited study abstracts
checks.details: All sourced empirical statements are corroborated by verbatim finding sentences or data in cited abstracts.

checks.name: Outcome direction fidelity (no benefit on null evidence)
checks.details: Outcome directions match cited evidence; no clinical benefit is claimed where randomized trials showed null outcomes.

checks.name: Numbers and percentages supported by selected records
checks.details: All statistics, percentages, and numerical values in slides and notes appear in the approved study records.

checks.name: Zero vocabulary drift from watch list terms
checks.details: Output text contains zero off-topic or ungrounded clinical terms from the integrity watch list.

checks.name: Framing slides display no numeric sources
checks.details: Framing and scoping slides show "none (framing slide)" and carry no numeric evidence sources.

checks.name: Sentence integrity and truncation check
checks.details: All slide bullets have complete syntax with zero mid-word cuts or trailing dangling stop words.

checks.name: Zero in-text citations in on-slide text or notes
checks.details: Zero in-text citations found. (Policy: study label prefixes like "Wang S, 2023:" are permitted at bullet start; in-text parenthetical citations or author-year prose citations are prohibited).

checks.name: Requested slide count present or documented shortfall
checks.details: Exact requested count confirmed: 15 slides generated.

checks.name: Abstract-only and conference abstract disclosure
checks.details: 15 selected records evaluated: 0 without abstract, 0 conference abstracts. Findings are based on titles and abstracts only; full texts were not read.

checks.name: Removed papers absent from active selection
checks.details: Active selection contains only approved studies (15 papers). All removed papers permanently excluded.

checks.name: API secrets are not exposed
checks.details: Zero API keys, private tokens, or credentials exposed in document payload or client bundle.

checks.name: English-only content
checks.details: All slide titles, objectives, slide text, visual descriptions, notes, and metadata are in English.
